questions.question: In a week, the weight of a bag of tea were 350 kg, 280 kg, 270 kg, 360 kg, 310 kg, 300 kg. The range (in kg) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The weight of a bag of tea was 350 kg, 280 kg, 270 kg, 360 kg, 310 kg, 300 kg

**Concept used:**

Range = Highest term - lowest term

**Calculation:**

Highest term = 360 kg

Lowest term = 270 kg

Range = 360 - 270 = 90 kg

**∴ Required range is 90**

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 10% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for ₹450. Had the discount not been given, the profit would have been 25%. What is the cost price (in ₹) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP = Rs. 450

Discount % = 10

**Concept used:**

SP = MP × (100 - discount%)

**Calculation:** 

MP × 90/100 = 450

MP = 500

Now,

CP × 125/100 = 500

CP = 400

**∴ The cost price (in ₹) of the article is 400**

questions.question: Two circles of radii 10 cm and 12 cm intersect each other and the length of their common chord is 16 cm. What is the distance (in cm) between their centres?
questions.solution:
Given:

PA = 10 cm

QA = 12 cm

AB = 16 cm

Concept used:

Pythagoras Theorem 

Distance between two centres divides the common chord in halves and is perpendicular to the common chord as well.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f357c9d16f589ee819a824fd43d4f5f7b87e77858f3f33c7f2df5498ec2072.png] 

AR = RB = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

AB is perpendicular to PQ. 

Hence, PQ divides AB in halves.

Now,

PR = sqrt {10² - 8²} = 6 cm

QR = sqrt {12² - 8² } = 4√5 cm

Thus, PQ = (6 + 4√5) cm

**∴ The distance between their centres is (6 + 4√5) cm.**

questions.question: There are 100 students in a class, out of which 70% are girls and others are boys. The average score of girls in a test is 20% more than that of boys. If the average score of all the students is 57, then what is the average score of boys?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 100

Girls = 70% of total

Average of all students = 57

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Girls = 70/100 × 100 = 70

Boys = 100 - 70 = 30

Let the average score of boys be 5x

⇒ Average score of girls = 6x

Total score of all = 57 × 100 = 5700

According to the question,

70 × 6x + 30 × 5x = 5700

⇒ 420x + 150x = 5700

⇒ 570x = 5700

⇒ x = 10

So, 5x = 50

**∴ Average score of boys is 50**

questions.question: A farmer borrowed ₹1,32,000 from a money lender to do cultivation in his field. The rate of interest is 12.5% p.a. compounded annually. At the end of two years, he cleared his loan by paying ₹1,07,062.50 and his scooter. The cost (in ₹) of the scooter is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal(P) = Rs. 132000

Rate of interest(r) = 12.5%

Time(t) = 2 years

He paid Rs. 107062.5 and his scooter

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

12.5% = 1/8

So,

Amount = 132000 × 9/8 × 9/8

⇒ 167062.5

So,

Price of the scooter = 167062.5 - 107062.5 = 60000

**∴ The cost (in ₹) of the scooter is 60000**

questions.question: A sells an article to B at 12% profit. B sells it to C at 9% loss. If C pays ₹15,288 for it, then at what price (in ₹) is the article purchased by A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the successive percentage ratio multiplier method:

Final Price = Initial Price × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100 × (100 − Loss%) ÷ 100

15288 = CP × (112 ÷ 100) × (91 ÷ 100)

CP = 15288 × (100 ÷ 112) × (100 ÷ 91) = 15000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Profit percentage for A = 12%

⇒ Loss percentage for B = 9%

⇒ Final price paid by C = ₹15,288

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Final SP = Initial CP × (100 ± Change%) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22f05fbfc088bfacaa6a741f8ef652be267e4102c707efab18fb50dca0b42fe8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial cost price for A be ₹x.

⇒ Cost price for B = x × (100 + 12) ÷ 100 = 1.12x

⇒ Cost price for C = 1.12x × (100 − 9) ÷ 100

⇒ Cost price for C = 1.12x × 0.91 = 1.0192x

⇒ We know C pays ₹15,288. Equating the values:

⇒ 1.0192x = 15288

⇒ x = 15288 ÷ 1.0192 = 15000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value goes through sequential percentage changes, the equivalent net change can be found using the formula: a + b + (a × b ÷ 100), taking profit as positive and loss as negative.

Chain System in Transactions

In a sequential chain of sales, the Selling Price (SP) for the seller automatically becomes the Cost Price (CP) for the next buyer. The successive multiplier method is the fastest way to compute final values.

Profit & Loss Basics

Profit and loss are always calculated on the base Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated otherwise. Formulas: SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 and SP = CP × (100 − L%) ÷ 100.

questions.question: 'A' alone can do a piece of work in 10 days and 'B' alone can do it in 15 days. 'A' and 'B' undertook to do the work for ₹42,000. With the help of 'C', they completed the work in 5 days. How much (in ₹) is to be paid to C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A alone can do the work in 10 days.

B alone can do the work in 15 days.

**Concept used:**

Total work = LCM of time taken by each person

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10 and 15 = 30 i.e total work

Efficiency of A = 30/10 = 3

Efficiency of B = 30/15 = 2

With the assistance of C they finished the work in 5 days.

Efficiency of A, B and C is 30/5 = 6

⇒ A + B + C = 6

⇒ C = 6 – 2 – 3 = 1

Their efficiency ratio is A : B : C = 3 : 2 : 1

Share of C = (1/6) × 42000 = 7000

**∴ Share of C is Rs. 7000**

questions.question: An aeroplane covers a distance at a speed of 190 km/h in 7 hours. To cover the distance in 4(3)/(4) hours, it must travel at a speed (in km/h) of:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1 / Time

Ratio of Time = T₁ : T₂ = 7 : 19/4 = 28 : 19

Ratio of Speed = S₁ : S₂ = 19 : 28

Given 19 units = 190 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 10 km/h

Required Speed = 28 units = 280 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 280 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial speed = 190 km/h

Initial time = 7 hours

New time = 4(3/4) hours = 19/4 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

New Speed = Total Distance ÷ New Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aec8f6505c48531e21d4f90d7372f35af499997087a30dcf564dd02bbf7b547.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 190 × 7 = 1330 km

⇒ New Speed = Total Distance ÷ New Time

⇒ New Speed = 1330 ÷ (19/4)

⇒ New Speed = 1330 × (4 / 19)

⇒ New Speed = 70 × 4 = 280 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 280 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed, Distance & Time Relationship

Distance = Speed × Time. For a constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time (S ∝ 1 / T).

Unit Conversions

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If two equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, Average Speed = (2ab) ÷ (a + b).

questions.question: When the price of sugar gets raised by 30%, a person increases his expenditure on sugar only by 12%. By what percentage (correct up to two decimal places) should he reduce his consumption of sugar so as to be able to maintain the same level of expenditure?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let both the initial price and expenditure be 100.

New Price = 100 + 30 = 130

New Expenditure = 100 + 12 = 112

Required reduction on the new price = 130 − 112 = 18

% Reduction in consumption = (18 ÷ 130) × 100 = 13.846% ≈ 13.85%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.85%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage increase in price of sugar = 30%

Percentage increase in expenditure = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Price × Consumption

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/706f9373854b97da9df0902a44acdcfc6899e002509a50eb6824d5d26b51821c.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the initial price be 100 and initial expenditure be 100.

⇒ Initial Consumption = 100 ÷ 100 = 1 unit

⇒ New Price = 100 + 30 = 130

⇒ New Expenditure = 100 + 12 = 112

⇒ New Consumption = 112 ÷ 130 = 56/65 units

⇒ Reduction in consumption = 1 − (56/65) = 9/65 units

⇒ Percentage reduction = [(9/65) ÷ 1] × 100

⇒ Percentage reduction = 900 ÷ 65 = 180/13 = 13.846%

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places, it becomes 13.85%.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.85%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

The percentage change is calculated as the ratio of the difference between the final and initial values to the initial value, multiplied by 100. Formula: % Change = [(New Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100.

Successive Percentage Change

If a quantity undergoes two consecutive percentage changes of a% and b%, the effective percentage change is calculated using the formula: Net % Change = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100.

Base Change Concept

If the price of a commodity increases by R%, the reduction in consumption required to keep the expenditure exactly the same is given by: Reduction % = [R ÷ (100 + R)] × 100.
</p

questions.question: Two trains of the same length are running on parallel tracks in the same direction at 44 km/h and 32 km/h. The faster train passes the other train in 72 seconds. What is the length (in m) of each train?
questions.solution:
**GIven:**

Speed of the two trains is 44 km/h and 32 km/h

**Concept used:**

Distance/Speed = Time

If both the trains are running on parallel tracks in same direction, the distance covered by the fastest train will be length of its and length of the smaller train

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be x meters.

Relative speed of fastest train = 44 – 32 = 12 km/hr = 12 × 5/18 = 10/3 m/s. 

According to the question,

2x/10/3 = 72

⇒ x = 120 m

**∴ The length of each train 120 metes.**

questions.question: Eight copies of a book can be bought for a certain sum payable at the end of a year and ten copies of the same book can be bought for the same sum in cash money. What is the rate percentage of the interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Eight copies of a book can be bought for a certain sum payable at the end of a year and ten copies of the same book can be bought for the same sum in cash money.

**Concept used:**

Simple interest = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

Let CP of each of the eight books be Rs. 1.

Total money for 8 books = Rs 8

Principle = Rs. 8 

Total money for 10 books = Rs 10

Extra amount paid = interest on the 7 books = 10 - 8 = Rs 2 

Interest at the end of the year = Rs. 2

Rate of interest = (2/8) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The rate of interest is 25%.**
